name: @omp-dev-team/openai-compatible
description: Register any OpenAI-compatible provider (LiteLLM, Ollama, vLLM, …) in OMP.
comment: The extension reads OAI_PROVIDER_NAME + OAI_PROVIDER_URL at startup, derives the API key from ~/.omp/<name>.key (never from env), registers the provider live via registerProvider, and exposes /oai-provider to re-list models on demand. install.sh/ps1 drive the same CLI for initial setup.
